
::: {#def-parent .theorem}
# Parent/child/ancestor/descendent

In a NPSEM-IE, if a random variable $X$ is an argument in the structural equation for a random variable $Y$ and $Y$ is an argument in the structural equation for a random variable $Z$. $Y$ and $Z$ are said to be descendants of $X$ and $X$ and $Y$ are said to be ancestors of $Z$. An ancestor that is one step away is called a parent and a descendant that is one step away is called a child. 

:::
